propositions: A CriteriaError raised during deterministic assemble-criteria step is classified as llm_unavailable by the generic degraded verdict builder, obscuring a local configuration fault as an LLM outage.
The workflow interpreter records typed exceptions only as undifferentiated strings, causing loss of identity discrimination at the verdict dispatch boundary.
Plan review must emit a distinct config-fault verdict with fail-closed INDETERMINATE disposition and actionable installed-build remediation guidance, without the llm_unavailable flag.
Genuine LLM provider outages and healthy workflows must remain unchanged after routing structured CriteriaError failures through a dedicated config-fault path.
Deterministic findings and blockers must survive config-fault verdict assembly, preserving fail-closed semantics without reusing LLM-outage classification.
The config-fault diagnostic must identify the running installed rebar build as the suspect source and direct operators to the repository checkout build.
